title: FOLLOW ON
author: William O. Cushing
stanzas: Down in the valley with my savior I would go, Where the flowers are blooming and the sweet waters flow; Everything He leads me I would follow, follow on, walking in His footsteps till the crown be won
Follow! follow! I would follow Jesus! Anywhere, everywhere, I would follow on! Follow! follow! I would follow Jesus! Everywhere He leads me I would follow on!
Down in the valley with my savior I would go, Where the storms are sweeping and the dark waters flow; With His hand to lead me I will never, never fear, Dangers cannot fright me if my Lord is near
Down in the valley, or upon the mountain steep, Close beside my Saviour I would my soul ever keep; He will lead safely in the path that He has trod, Up to where they gather on the hills of God.
